title: Gaussian Mixture Copula Processes for Irregular Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2605.23632v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Gaussian Mixture Copula Processes (GMCP), a conditional copula process for irregularly sampled multivariate time series (IMTS) that is expressive and marginalization consistent at the same time. Existing conditional copula processes achieve only one of the two. Gaussian copula processes are consistent by construction but confined to elliptical dependence, whereas attentional copulas such as TACTiS-2 are far more expressive but neither preserve the marginals they are built on nor guarantee that integrating out a target point returns the joint over the remaining ones. GMCP closes this gap by inferring the parameters of a Gaussian Mixture Copula from the context in a way that guarantees consistent marginalization. This yields a non-elliptical copula process with tractable likelihood and consistency guarantees. Our experiments show that copulas equipped with MargFlow, a normalizing-flow model for the univariate marginals fit

translated_abstract: 我们提出了高斯混合Copula过程（GMCP），这是一种针对不规则采样多变量时间序列（IMTS）的条件Copula过程，同时具备强表达能力和边缘化一致性。现有的条件Copula过程只能实现二者之一：高斯Copula过程在构造上天然满足一致性，但仅局限于椭圆型依赖结构；而诸如TACTiS-2等基于注意力的Copula虽然表达能力强得多，却既不能保留其所依赖的边缘分布，也无法保证对某个目标点积分后能得到其余点上的联合分布。GMCP通过从上下文中推断高斯混合Copula的参数来弥合这一差距，其推断方式保证了边缘化的一致性。由此得到一种非椭圆的Copula过程，兼具可处理的似然函数和一致性保证。我们的实验表明，配备MargFlow（一种用于单变量边缘分布的正则化流模型）的Copula……
tldr: 提出了高斯混合Copula过程（GMCP），一种面向不规则采样多变量时间序列的条件Copula过程，首次同时实现了强表达能力与边缘化一致性，兼具可处理的似然和一致性保证。
en_tdlr: We propose Gaussian Mixture Copula Processes (GMCP), a conditional copula process for irregularly sampled multivariate time series that is the first to combine high expressiveness with marginalization consistency, offering tractable likelihood and consistency guarantees.
